integrity: All calculations and abstract group identifications have direct proofs in RESULT.md. Two independent finite enumerations corroborate small dimensions but do not certify the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only the finite field F4, weighted single directed cycles, and F4-rational automorphism groups are classified. General finite fields and arbitrary graphs are not covered. Unindexed equivalents and interpretation of the 2025 weighted-graph splitting formulation remain originality risks; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: A complete splitting trichotomy for weighted-cycle evolution algebras over \(\mathbb F_4\)
